# Replacement Shaving Heads for Norelco RQ12 and RQ11 Series Shavers

Keep your Norelco shaver cutting cleanly with this full replacement shaving head set. Designed to fit the SensoTouch 3D 1200 series and compatible Philips RQ10 and RQ11 models, it gives you a practical, budget-friendly way to refresh your shaver without replacing the whole device.

## Features That Matter

The three independent floating cutter heads rotate in all directions and follow the contours of your face and neck. This intelligent facial contouring system keeps skin closer to the blades, so fine neck hairs are easier to capture. The set includes the complete shaving head unit, and an extensive compatibility list covers dozens of model numbers, including RQ1250, RQ1260, RQ1280, and RQ1290.

## Benefits for Your Daily Shave

Each replacement head helps you keep a comfortable, close shave in your daily routine. The flexible cutter design adapts to the shape of your jawline and neck, so you spend less time going over the same patches. Replacing the head every six months, as recommended, helps maintain consistent performance.

## Why Choose This Replacement Set

Compared with original Philips heads, this aftermarket set offers a lower price point while delivering a fit that works well for many owners. Once the cutters settle in after a few shaves, customers report a smooth, comfortable finish.

## Order Your Replacement Set Today

Check your shaver's model number against the compatibility list, then add this full replacement set to your cart. Refresh your shave today.
